sources.dataset: Mass canine vaccination campaign against rabies in Ranchi, India
sources.publication_rule: One profile only for a source DogId marked Free Roaming with valid original GPS. Owner Present and missing/invalid GPS records stay staged. Survey rows are aggregate coverage only.

sources.organization: Humane World for Animals (formerly Humane Society International)
sources.restrictions: The accompanying PLOS article is CC BY 4.0 and points to GitHub for all data/code, but the repository containing the raw data has no explicit data license. Do not publish until reuse is confirmed.
sources.publication_rule: Stage 20,915 stable-ID clinical rows and 164 route-survey aggregates. Publish neither while the raw-data licence is unresolved. Never assign route coordinates to individual dogs.

sources.dataset: Territory and Group Structure of Free-ranging Dogs
sources.publication_rule: Census-site and dog-group counts are aggregate records. The workbook does not contain animal-level GPS or stable individual identities, so it creates no dog profiles.

sources.dataset: Data for Resting Site Preferences in Free-ranging Dogs
sources.notes: 6,047 dated observations across 66 groups and 445 source identifiers are staged. No source GPS is supplied, so profiles are not published.

sources.dataset: Free-ranging dogs prefer petting over food
sources.notes: 103 real adult free-ranging dogs with IDs, locality and sex; no GPS or observation date suitable for public map profiles.

sources.dataset: The great Indian joint families of free-ranging dogs
sources.notes: 23 mother-litter units in 15 groups are legitimate research records, but the released table has no individual GPS.

sources.dataset: Free-ranging dog movement in the Western Ghats
sources.license: Article CC BY 4.0; Movebank dataset license unresolved
sources.restrictions: Do not republish raw Movebank fixes until the dataset's own license is verified. One profile per tracked animal, never per GPS fix.

sources.notes: Every file must pass subject, locality, creator and image-license validation; obvious pets and duplicate events are excluded.

sources.dataset: Conservatively filtered georeferenced India domestic-dog observations
sources.notes: Domestic dog does not imply stray. Uncertain observations must remain staged and iNaturalist-origin GBIF duplicates must be excluded.

sources.dataset: India dog occurrences with usable coordinates/media
sources.notes: Exclude records whose origin is iNaturalist when already imported from the source API.

sources.publication_rule: Eight zone estimates and the citywide neutering percentage are aggregate facts only; no dog profiles are created.

sources.dataset: Mumbai stray-dog census and ABC status 2014
sources.publication_rule: The official city total and sterilised/unsterilised totals are one aggregate city record; no dog profiles are created.

sources.organization: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
sources.publication_rule: The official national, state and 710 district stray-dog totals are aggregate statistics only and are never expanded into dog profiles.

sources.dataset: Chennai street-dog survey and ABC programme disclosures
sources.publication_rule: Citywide survey estimates, health percentages, annual catching counts and five ABC centres are aggregate or infrastructure records only.
